title: Pager database filename observation

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerFilename returns the Pager-owned full pathname, except that legacy user-facing callers may request an empty name for memory-backed database files.

external_source_responsibilities: Pager opening records the canonical pathname and VFS OPEN_MEMORY result
The memdb VFS identity helper recognizes the wrapped memdb transport
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete memory-name branch and pathname return are assigned and exercised for ordinary and memdb-backed runtime Pagers.

outputs: Borrowed sentinel-terminated pathname or empty sentinel string
contracts.ownership: The returned name remains Pager-owned, except the static empty string; no transfer.
contracts.state_and_results: When null_if_memdb is true and the opened file reported OPEN_MEMORY or the VFS is the memdb wrapper, return empty. Otherwise return the exact Pager filename, including memory names needed for internal matching when suppression is false.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Pure observation; no lock, callback, or I/O.

representation_differences: Zig returns a sentinel slice rather than a raw const char pointer.
Runtime Pager records the VFS OPEN_MEMORY output explicitly in addition to checking the memdb wrapper identity; this covers memory-file adapters without inferring from arbitrary VFS names.

oracle.protocol: Open an ordinary Pager and require its name with suppression both false and true; open a memdb-VFS Pager and require the exact name without suppression and empty with suppression.
oracle.normalization: Filename bytes and empty/non-empty selection compare exactly.

assurance.continuation: Pure observation preserves all owner state.

integration.native_call_path: Pager.databaseName serves internal Pager filename policy; the public connection filename API separately preserves user-visible names and schema aliases.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C ordinary/memdb filename differential, caller audit, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Audit remaining internal shared-cache and URI filename consumers.

implementation_spans: src/core/pager.zig Pager.open/databaseName/tests and src/core/vfs.zig memdb identity/open output were reviewed
callers: Legacy user-facing filename reporting passes suppression true
Internal shared-cache matching passes suppression false
Runtime Pager trace covers ordinary and memdb transports
callees: sqlite3IsMemdb and Pager memDb state in the source
VFS OPEN_MEMORY result and vfs.isMemdbVfs in Zig
assertions_branches_cleanup: All three generated branch/return blocks are assigned
Memory suppression is conditional on the caller flag
upstream_tests: Upstream URI, memdb, shared-cache, and filename API tests exercise both modes
Project Pager and public memdb API suites exercise ordinary and memory-visible names
